about: Researcher classification. Everything in this file is the tracker maintainer's judgement, not something the documents state. Roles may have several values per document. Document types from a registry (IETF Datatracker) are taken from the registry and are not listed here.

roles.name: Identity
roles.description: Who the agent or workload is (includes workload identity).

roles.name: Authorization
roles.description: What the agent may do and on whose behalf (includes delegation).

roles.name: Telemetry
roles.description: How agent activity is represented as spans, attributes or events.

roles.name: Tool interaction
roles.description: Protocols through which agents call tools or other agents.

roles.name: Provenance
roles.description: Where an artefact or record came from and whether it was altered.

roles.name: Audit record
roles.description: Formats for records of individual agent actions.

roles.name: Audit control
roles.description: Requirements that the evidence has to satisfy (controls, risk lists).

maturity_rule.about: How the raw state reported by each registry is normalised. The raw state is a document fact; this mapping is a researcher rule.

coverage.about: Researcher's statement of scope: which areas of AI agent audit criteria the tracker covers. It describes what is tracked; it does not claim that nothing is missing.
coverage.not_an_audit_tool: The tracker does not audit agents and holds no organisation's evidence (agent inventories, logs, access records, approvals). It maps the documents an auditor could use as criteria.

areas.examples: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions, proposals for agent identity and IAM attributes
areas.note: Status, commits and proposals tracked automatically.

areas.examples: IETF Internet-Drafts on agent audit trails and authorisation-decision records
areas.note: Three individual drafts; status and citations per revision.

areas.examples: WIMSE AIMS, NIST NCCoE project; OAuth token exchange, DPoP, SPIFFE
areas.note: AIMS and NCCoE are tracked. OAuth Token Exchange (RFC 8693) and DPoP (RFC 9449): status only. SPIFFE appears only as citations.

areas.examples: OWASP agentic and MCP lists; ISO/IEC 27001 A.8.15; PCI DSS Requirement 10; NIST SP 800-53 (AU, IA, AC)
areas.note: Status only for the controls; requirement links exist for the OWASP lists only.

areas.examples: EU AI Act Article 12 (record-keeping) and Article 26(6) (deployers keeping logs)
areas.note: Checked by hand. Amendments are not tracked.

areas.examples: ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF and its Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1)
areas.note: Organisation-level management and risk requirements, not evidence for individual agent actions.

areas.examples: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 families AU, IA and AC
areas.note: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, through NIST's OSCAL content. Listed under audit controls above.
MCP and A2A specifications: latest change only.
SCITT architecture (RFC 9943): status only. in-toto, SLSA and Sigstore are not tracked.

areas.examples: Guidance on auditing AI systems from audit and payment-security bodies
Agent inventories, logs, access records, human approvals
areas.note: By design: the tracker covers criteria, not evidence.

coverage.question_scope: The researcher's evidence questions (not yet published) focus on identity, authorisation and record integrity. Basic log elements such as time, origin of the event and the affected resource, and the model version, are not among them yet.
coverage.scope_frozen: The set of tracked areas is fixed for now. New documents are added only within these areas; status-only tracking is preferred to rating.
